name: Slugger-9
bio: Built for the batting cage. Found out bullets come in faster than fastballs, and liked it.
notes: From the owner's Drive folder (uploaded 2026-11-01): an unrigged image-to-3D GLB in a T-pose (3.1M triangles, 4096 px maps), rigged here from landmarks. Named here; the owner reviews it on the grip and portrait sheets. A white and navy robot in a batting helmet. The owner's own Meshy model. Landmarks as found on the mesh, mirrored, with the shoulder joint moved out under the shoulder pad (found at the chest); hands measured 19.5-20 cm. Its plating is thousands of small texture islands (12,559 seam vertices kept apart; every texture-safe cut stopped over the budget: 21.3k, 20.8k with seamWeld), so it is built with `surface: rebake` (2026-11-01): the full download cut with its seams closed, laid out afresh and its colour and normal maps painted from the download (docs/CHARACTERS.md). Licence (the owner's rule, 2026-11-06: models from the owner's Drive are Meshy Community CC0 unless the owner says they made them): recorded as Meshy Community, CC0 per the owner; it was recorded as owned before, with no record of the owner saying they made it (provenance audit, HANDOFF.md "Intake of 2026-11-06"). Post URL pending; if the owner made it, it goes back to owned.
